title: ivcbench: An Immune-Aware Benchmark of Perturbation-Prediction Generalization
description: Revision package v1.2.5 for Toward Immune Virtual Cells (Lee and Ryu; BIB-26-1553). The panel contains 58 model-by-task evaluations: 46 native, eight adapted and four diagnostic, spanning 16 of the 17 method and comparator groups surveyed, with 9 / 9 / 10 / 10 / 11 / 9 entries across the six reported settings. Every reported cell is scored against a two-member universal floor, a cell-mean and a linear-PCA shift, whose stronger member binds per task. CPU replay re-scores Pearson-delta from the 1,401 deposited mean-profile bundles (1,149 model and 252 simple-reference inputs) in seconds and without a GPU; it does not reconstruct cell distributions or retrain models. Native chemCPA supplies the held-compound CPA result. Non-native CPA and scGen executions remain excluded; STATE's T3/T4/T5 executions were re-run through the corrected runner and STATE is native on all six settings. Soskic results concern supplied residualized coordinates. Source data, figures, document builders and execution provenance accompany the package.
